commands.command: node -e 'const a=require("node:assert/strict"),f=require("node:fs"),p="docs/versions/pilot-agent-intent-2026-09-24/",x=f.readFileSync(p+"physics-material-design.md","utf8").split("## B4 十九读字段与额外读取边界").at(-1),y=f.readFileSync(p+"mana-ledger-design.md","utf8").split("## B4 固定投影审计原子").at(-1),rx=/`((?:Read-B4-(?:main|aux|heat|material)-R[0-3])|(?:POST-B4-(?:main|heat|material)))`/,rows=s=>s.split(/\r?\n/).filter(z=>z.startsWith("| `")&&rx.test(z)),q=rows(x),r=rows(y);a.equal(q.length,19);a.equal(r.length,19);let M=0,T=0,F=0,E=0;for(let i=0;i<19;i++){let u=q[i].split("|"),v=r[i].split("|"),id=u[1].match(rx)[1],norm=s=>s.replace(/`/g,"").replace(/；\d+\s*$/,"").replace(/；/g,";").replace(/\s/g,"");a.equal(v[1].match(rx)[1],id);a.equal(norm(u[2]),norm(v[2]),id);let pairs=[...v[2].matchAll(/[A-Z]\.\{([^}]+)\}/g)],fcount=pairs.reduce((n,z)=>n+z[1].split(",").length,0),ecount=pairs.length,cost=v[4].match(/(\d+) M \/ (\d+) tick/);a.equal(v[3].trim(),fcount+"/"+ecount,id);a.equal(+cost[1],ecount===2?1:2,id);a.equal(+cost[2],1+fcount+ecount,id);F+=fcount;E+=ecount;M+=+cost[1];T+=+cost[2]}a.deepEqual([F,E,M,T,50-5-10-M],[199,53,29,271,6]);console.log("PASS mdai exact 19 projections and 44 M / 6 M paper account")'
